description: April 15 birthday meaning: Aries decan 3, birthday number 6, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an April 15 birthday falls in Aries, in the third decan, with Mars as the sign's ruler and Jupiter as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 6. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aries is cardinal and fire.

sections.heading: Personality of an April 15 birthday
paragraphs: April 15 brings warmth and responsibility, via a birthday number of 6, into the late, Jupiter-coloured stretch of Aries. The Sun stands near twenty-five degrees into the sign. The reading is a generous protector: someone who shares good fortune readily, hosts well and tends to feel personally accountable for the morale of a group.

By noon UTC on April 15, the Sun has normally reached roughly 25° of Aries. That places the date in the Aries decan that astrologers give to Jupiter, the third of three. The last ten degrees of Aries fall under Jupiter, the planet that governs Sagittarius, so this decan is usually read as the most philosophical version of the Ram. The urge to act is joined by an urge to understand why, and to go further, physically or intellectually. Astrologers tend to describe these mid-April birthdays as restless explorers who argue for principles as hotly as for themselves. Jupiter can widen the horizon and also the to-do list, so enthusiasm may outrun follow-through. At its best, this decan mixes Aries nerve with a broad, hopeful outlook that makes other people braver about their own plans.

sections.heading: Numerology of the April 15 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 15th, the compound 1 + 5 reduces to 6, so the birthday number is 6. Here the 1's self-reliance and the 5's curiosity pour into the 6's caring, responsible nature. People with this birthday are often described as warm, magnetic and generous, with an adventurous side that keeps their care from becoming heavy. They may be drawn to roles where they look after others while still having room to move, such as teaching, hosting or creative work for families. As a supporting influence, the 15th tends to show in a lively, affectionate presence.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same April 15 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 1 for 1980, 11 for 1990, 3 for 2000 and 4 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: April 15 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 15 is the 105th day of the year (106th in a leap year). In most years Taurus season is under way by April 20, 5 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for an April 15 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. April 15 is also the birthday of Leonhard Euler (1707), Kim Il-sung (1912) and Emma Watson (1990).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 15?
faq.answer: April 15 is Aries in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Aries, which tradition links with Jupiter.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 15?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 15 the Life Path is 8 in 1960, 9 in 1970, 1 in 1980, 11 in 1990, 3 in 2000, 4 in 2010 and 5 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 6 for everyone born on the 15th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 15?
faq.answer: By April 15 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 15?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with an April 15 birthday are Leonhard Euler (1707), Kim Il-sung (1912) and Emma Watson (1990). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
